source: Verify No Additional Users Added to Emergency Group
Verify Emergency Group Contains Only Managers

users 59, 170 and 31 are all managers, so no other member also means no non-manager member

Verify Number of Managers in Entitlement.evidence: tests only seed facts: Entitlement Verification (group 5) already has exactly three active managers (59, 170 and 31) before the agent acts, and no listed tool removes a membership

Verify No Additional Users Added to Emer.evidence: its zero count on the seed comes only from the group not existing yet; it tests that the agent adds no one beyond the three managers, the boundary of the selection, not a seed fact, so it is kept and carried by the stay

Verify Emergency Group Contains Only Man.evidence: its zero count on the seed comes only from the group not existing yet; it tests that the agent adds no non-manager, the boundary of the selection, not a seed fact, so it is kept and carried by the stay

notes:
disagreement: value: source of the group requirement: one pass names both the creation check and the membership check, the other the creation check alone; kept both because the membership check finds the group by name and type, which only the group requirement ties to group 81.
disagreement: disposition: 'Verify No Additional Users Added to Emergency Group': kept in one pass, weak in the other because it counts zero on the seed; chose kept because the zero comes only from the group not existing yet, and the check tests what the agent must not add (the boundary of the selection), not a seed fact.
disagreement: disposition: 'Verify Emergency Group Contains Only Managers': kept in one pass, weak in the other because it counts zero on the seed; chose kept for the same reason: it tests that no non-manager is added to the new group, not a seed fact.
"Entitlement Verification" is read as the group of that exact name (group 5); the suffixed groups Entitlement Verification_2, _3 and _4 are separate groups whose eleven managers are excluded, in line with the benchmark's member list.
The membership requirements fix the new group by its assumed id 81; the group requirement ties that id to the name, type and active flag, so together they carry the benchmark's name-joined membership checks.
The benchmark's single IN-list membership check passes with a duplicate membership standing in for a missing manager; one requirement per manager closes that gap.
The acting user (user 32, Jose Roberson) is an admin but inactive on the seed; the policy lets admins create groups and memberships and its activity rule governs assignees, so the requirements assume the request is carried out.
